csv_project_name: Architectural Svc for Permit Ready Housing Plan Program
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Greensboro is soliciting proposals to secure a professional, architecture and design firm or teams of such firms with experience and technical qualifications ( Applicant ) to establish a permit-ready housing plan program ( Program ).The program is to be jointly designed and implemented by the City and selected Applicant to encourage and expedite the construction of a variety of housing types throughout Greensboro. The Program is expected to be available citywide, with a primary focus on vernacular architecture and design.

title: Architectural Services for Permit-Ready Housing Plan Program
short_description: Architectural services to develop permit-ready housing plans for diverse citywide housing types.
project_scope: Citywide program in Greensboro to jointly design and implement a permit-ready housing plan program focused primarily on vernacular architecture and design, intended to encourage and expedite construction of a variety of housing types throughout the city.
services: Architectural services, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, housing and urban development, planning/master planning, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an architectural and planning program for housing prototypes, not a structurally demanding bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Focus is on permit-ready housing plans and vernacular design rather than innovative long-span or complex structural engineering.
- Includes civil engineering and planning components, but no clear structural design scope for complex load-bearing systems.
- Could offer strategic teaming potential with architects, yet overall fit for sbp is limited.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice describes a citywide permit-ready housing plan program for multiple housing types, but provides no number of prototypes, unit counts, floor areas, or implementation budget. A realistic construction cost estimate is therefore not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The procurement is for professional architectural and design services to establish a program, but the scope, deliverables, number of plan sets, and contract value are not stated, so no reliable fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Professional architecture and design firm or team with experience and technical qualifications relevant to establishing a permit-ready housing plan program; disciplines requested include architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, housing and urban development, planning/master planning, and urban studies/planning/design.
contracting_authority: City of Greensboro, Greensboro, North Carolina, USA. Contact: Samuel Hunter. Email: samuel.hunter@greensboro-nc.gov. Phone: 336-373-2509. Fax: 336-373-2338. Website: https://www.greensboro-nc.gov/departments/housing-neighborhood-development/housing-services/landlords-developers/requests-for-proposals
notes: Project funding: ARPA. Pre-submittal meeting: 2026-06-08 11:00 AM EDT; RSVP to samuel.hunter@greensboro-nc.gov; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 2026-06-29 05:00 PM EDT. Contract participation goal: 10% M/WBE. Solicitation documents available online.
